profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Datadog | Ex-Meta, Ex-AMZN
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Led Shift Left initiative for CI; created AI skill to validate changes locally and filter out at CI time, shortening developer loop and decreasing company compute. Multi-repo and product collaboration (Instagram, Whatsapp, etc.)

- Increased Starlark parser speed by 2x by moving to Recursive Descent Pratt parser

- Reduced Resident Size Set (RSS) of application by 14GB (36%)

- Increased JSON parsing in application by 2.6x on target determination invocations.

-12% CPU reduction investigation by avoiding redundant DashMap insertions

- Investigated Parallel Base Revision Retry and Same Revision Retry; wrote write up but did not pursue

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Rewrote developer build tooling from Ruby/Java to Rust, cutting command execution time by 98%.

-  Designed a testing framework for multi-platform command line tooling (Amazon Linux 2, macOS, Ubuntu, Windows).

- Conceptualized and directed the company-wide rollout of CLI tooling, ensuring adoption by tens of thousands of developers and enabling safe, efficient deployments.

- Led a cross-functional project to enhance pipeline stability and streamline release process, reducing manual engineer interventions by 90%.

- Optimized performance to improve artifact download speeds by 20%, enhancing developer productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created Request Hedging library to help reduce tail dependency latency by up to 86%

- Migrated GraphQL service with 170+ dependencies from GitHub Enterprise to Amazon Code repository and build system 

- Created and owned code sync and build mechanism to ease transition for contributors and reduce toil for developers 

- Migrated service and documentation infrastructure from Terraform to Amazon Cloud Development Kit (CDK) 

- Enabled Brotli compression, decreasing bytes per response by 7% across desktop browsers 

- Enhanced contributor experience with code ownership, required reviewers, and analyzers 

- Collaborated with builder platform team to design and implement contributor experience enhancements

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Microsoft Teams
positions.description:
- Lead implementation efforts for Teams Connect – Shared Channels, enabling customers to increase productivity through native identity

- Migrated 12 existing APIs from monolithic middle tier layer to microservice, enabling faster deployment and rapid iteration for engineers

- Integrated Newman-based integration test for running locally and in CI/CD build with reporting, resulting in fewer bugs and more productive engineers.

- Upgraded back-end templating service from .NET Framework 4.7.2 to .NET Standard 2.0 and .NET Core 2.1, resulting in more stable, performant, and up-to-date code.

- Mentored 2 Software Engineer I coworkers for code implementation, best practices, and career advice

- Activated code analyzers and rules, fixing under-the-radar issues and aligning engineers on coding standards.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead protype efforts for migrating .NET Framework 4.7.2 C# SDK to .NET Standard 2.0, fulfilling #1 customer ask

- Owned and maintained source code repositories, build/release definitions, and pipelines in Azure DevOps ensuring engineer velocity and ease of deployment

- Lead prototype efforts for migrating front end framework from AngularJS to React to improve performance and consume common component libraries

- Mentored 3 interns in software development process on front end, back end, and build/release process

- Migrated monolithic system to 3 microservices for tighter iteration loop and faster deployments

positions.title: Modern Application Consultant
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented 2 Service Fabric applications with Azure IoT Team for the Microsoft Connected Vehicle Platform, enabling automotive customers to consume analytical

- Developed feature test and integration tests to ensure code reliability and feature success

- Strategized with customers on implementation for Xamrin cross platform mobile app functionality for more rich feature set and wider customer reach.

- Designed and implemented cross platform application for Microsoft Band to display org-wide on-boarding strategy

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Hardware Research & Development Co-Op for Itron, Inc.

- Designed and assembled automated live load test for real-world simulation of products.

- Developed Linux kernel module to record in-field sensor data for diagnosing issues.

- Created packet verification application for high-speed board-to-board communication

positions.title: Mobile Development Intern
positions.description:
Intern for the South Carolina Research Authority

- helped develop and maintain server-side of my.Clemson app

- Created iOS mobile apps for smooth future native conversion

- Upgrade existing IT tools for managing student data

- Designed RoboMonitor, and registered on the App Store

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical Engineering; minor in Computer Science
